mapper.select: SELECT id,version,title,question_count FROM risk_questionnaire WHERE status=1 AND deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id,version,title,question_count FROM risk_questionnaire WHERE id=#{id} AND status=1 AND deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' FOR SHARE
SELECT id,sort_no,title,options FROM risk_question WHERE questionnaire_id=#{id} AND deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' ORDER BY sort_no ASC FOR SHARE
SELECT id FROM user WHERE id=#{id} AND role=1 AND status=1 AND deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO risk_profile(user_id,risk_level,evaluated_at,valid_until) VALUES (#{userId},#{riskLevel},#{evaluatedAt},#{validUntil}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE risk_level=#{riskLevel},evaluated_at=#{evaluatedAt},valid_until=#{validUntil},deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000'
mapper.update: UPDATE idempotency_key SET response_digest=#{digest} WHERE idem_key=#{key}
